title: Irish Skillet Tempeh
description: A nutritious and flavorful skillet dish featuring tempeh and inspired by Irish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced onion and cook until slightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes and cook until slightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the trimmed green beans and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tempeh, breaking it into small pieces, and cook until heated through.
Season with skillet seasoning and serve hot.
